timeline.timelineHelp: Drag clips/playhead · Edge snapping · Selection duration = generation duration
timeline.previewEmpty: Move the red playhead over a video clip to preview that position
timeline.noPreviewVideo: No video is available for preview
timeline.previewNote: Preview uses a low-resolution silent proxy only. Generation reads the original video; the track switch controls whether source audio is referenced.
timeline.segmentNote: Drag from the libraries above; Picture / Audio numbering restarts at 1 for each segment
timeline.externalDrop: Drop to import video, reference images, or reference audio
timeline.uploadBusy: A file is still uploading; try again shortly
timeline.unsupportedFile: Unsupported file. Drop an image, audio file, or video.
timeline.disableVideoAudio: Click to keep the video reference but omit its source audio
timeline.proxyGenerating: Generating a low-resolution proxy; the first preview may take a moment…
timeline.noClipAtPlayhead: No video clip at the red playhead
timeline.movePlayheadFirst: Move the red playhead onto a video clip first
timeline.noClipInspector: No clip selected. Click a video clip to enter its position and trim values precisely.
timeline.editableModeStatus: Editable reference: the original subject is not fixed
timeline.boundaryModeStatus: Only the first/last boundary frames are fixed
timeline.fixedGuideStatus: Fixed Guide: preserve the original image frame by frame
timeline.segmentsCreated: Created {count} material segments. Drag images and audio into the corresponding segment.
timeline.segmentsDisabled: Material segmentation disabled; all images and audio will be used.
timeline.segmentAssetTitle: Drag to reorder within this segment, or reuse in another segment
timeline.segmentPromptMatch: Matches prompt index {index} · numbering starts at 1
timeline.playheadInsideClip: The playhead must be inside the selected clip
timeline.noMatchingGap: There is no gap between current video clips
timeline.tooLarge: The file exceeds the plug-in's 512 MiB safety limit
timeline.noVideoTrack: The uploaded file contains no video track
timeline.noAudioTrack: The uploaded file contains no audio track
